title: Modulating JAK2/STAT3 signaling by quercetin in Qiling Baitouweng Tang: a potential therapeutic approach for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
authors: Zhan, Xin-Zhuo; Wei, Tian-Hua; Huang, Chen; Yu, Hui; Chen, Xiao-Li; Kong, Xiang-Tu; Shang, Zhi-Hao; Sun, Shan-Liang; Lu, Meng-Yi; Ni, Hai-Wen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方QLBTWT通过槲皮素调控JAK2/STAT3信号通路治疗弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤，涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Qiling Baitouweng Tang (QLBTWT) is a traditional clinical formula for treating diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), but its molecular action is not fully understood. This research is utilized in silico analysis and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC‒MS/MS) to identify the active constituents of QLBTWT with anti-DLBCL properties and their targets. The study identified 14 compounds, including quercetin, naringenin, and astilbin, as potentially effective against DLBCL. Molecular modeling highlighted the favorable interaction of quercetin with the JAK2 protein. In vitro studies confirmed the ability of quercetin to inhibit DLBCL cell growth and migration while inducing apoptosis and causing G2/M phase cell cycle arrest. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that quercetin binds to JAK2 as a type II inhibitor. In vivo studies in U2932 xenograft models demonstrated that QLBTWT inhibited tumor growth in a dose-dependent manner, which was associated with the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway. Overall, this study elucidates the therapeutic effect of QLBTWT on DLBCL through quercetin-mediated suppression of the JAK2/STAT3 pathway, offering novel therapeutic insights for DLBCL.
abstract_zh: 杞苓白头翁汤（QLBTWT）是一种治疗弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）的传统临床方剂，但其分子作用机制尚未完全阐明。本研究采用计算机模拟分析和液相色谱-串联质谱（LC‒MS/MS）技术，以鉴定QLBTWT中具有抗DLBCL活性的有效成分及其靶点。研究确定了14种化合物，包括槲皮素、柚皮素和落新妇苷，可能对DLBCL具有潜在疗效。分子建模强调了槲皮素与JAK2蛋白的有利相互作用。体外研究证实了槲皮素抑制DLBCL细胞生长和迁移的能力，同时诱导细胞凋亡并引起G2/M期细胞周期阻滞。分子动力学模拟揭示槲皮素作为II型抑制剂与JAK2结合。在U2932异种移植模型中的体内研究表明，QLBTWT以剂量依赖性方式抑制肿瘤生长，这与JAK2/STAT3信号通路相关。总体而言，本研究阐明了QLBTWT通过槲皮素介导的JAK2/STAT3通路抑制对DLBCL的治疗效果，为DLBCL提供了新的治疗见解。
